attempts.text:
**The window opens on a short spine.** Columns 0 to 3, `cusF` to `cusS`, are carried by 93 to 100% of chromosomes, all persistent, in a region of plasticity in 0.2 to 94% of calls. The model names 98 to 99% of them, fewest at column 1, `cusC`, 98%.

**A single fork and variable stretch runs to the window's end**, columns 4 to 79, carried by 28 to 88%, 51 persistent and 25 shell.

**The model names more genes on the spine columns than on the fork and variable ones**, 98 against 90%, and hesitates less there, 0.10 against 0.58 bits. It hesitates most at column 6, `ybcH`, a fork column, 1.98 bits.

**The window ends in the `acr` genes**, columns 77 to 79, `acrA` to `tomB`, carried by 46 to 38%.

**Across the window it names 90% of genes**, 0.55 bits on average, perplexity 1.7 families. Inside a region of plasticity it hesitates more than outside, 1.01 against 0.20 bits, and names fewer genes, 82% against 97%.

label: cusF
facts:
[W] WINDOW: the cusF window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor cusF, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 3,163 to 3,242 from dnaA. Read in 535 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying cusF once); 42,800 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
[T] TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
[G] WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 90% of genes, 0.55 bits on average (perplexity 1.7 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 23,836 calls, named 99%, 0.16 bits; shell 18,389 calls, named 81%, 0.99 bits; cloud 575 calls, named 22%, 3.14 bits. Outside an RGP 23,962 calls, named 97%, 0.20 bits; inside an RGP 18,838 calls, named 82%, 1.01 bits. Columns: 4 spine, 57 fork, 19 variable.
[C] COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (1.01 against 0.20 bits) and names fewer genes (82% against 97%); 18,838 of the 42,800 calls are inside an RGP.
[H] HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 6 (ybcH, a fork column) 1.98 bits, RGP 95%; column 4 (nrfB, a fork column) 1.92 bits, RGP 94%; column 7 (envY, a fork column) 1.53 bits, RGP 95%. The 26 columns (columns 2-15 and 24-35) where most calls are in an RGP: named 86%, 0.82 bits on average; the other 54 columns: named 92%, 0.43 bits.
[M] BY KIND OF COLUMN (computed, over the columns with calls): the 4 spine columns: named 98%, 0.10 bits on average; the 76 fork and variable columns: named 90%, 0.58 bits. The model names more genes on the spine columns than on the fork and variable ones, and hesitates less there. Its most hesitant column, 6, is a fork column.
[L] STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
[S1] 1. columns 0-3 (4 columns) spine: share 93-100%, all P, RGP 0.2-94%. Genes: cusF, cusC "Cu(+)/Ag(+) efflux RND transporter…", cusR, cusS. named 98-99% (mean 98%), fewest named at column 1 (cusC), named 98%; no column of this stretch hesitates more than 0.13 bits (column 2 (cusR)).
[S2] 2. columns 4-79 (76 columns) fork and variable columns: share 28-88%, 51 P, 25 S, RGP 12-95%. named 74-96% (mean 90%), fewest named at column 4, named 74%; most hesitant at column 6, 1.98 bits.
